sprints.name: Sprint 1: Critical Blockers & Fixes
sprints.goal: Fix production blockers and data integrity issues

sprints.name: Sprint 2: Authentication & Security
sprints.goal: Unify authentication systems and implement security best practices

sprints.name: Sprint 3: Code Quality & Maintainability
sprints.goal: Reduce technical debt and improve code organization

sprints.name: Sprint 4: Offline Sync & Scalability
sprints.goal: Unify offline systems and prepare for scale

issues.title: Analyze Current KDS UI Implementation
issues.description: Document current mock data usage in KDS screens. Identify all mock data in expo.tsx, station.tsx, and plating.tsx. Document data structures needed from context.

issues.title: Connect Expo Screen to useKDSInventory()
issues.description: Replace mock courses with real data from context. Import useKDSInventory hook and replace mockCourses, mockTableGroups, and mockFiredCourses with real data.

issues.title: Connect Station Screen to Real Context
issues.description: Replace mock items with real order items from context. Import useKDSInventory hook and implement proper grouping by fired course.

issues.title: Connect Plating Screen to Real Context
issues.description: Replace mock courses with real completion status. Import useKDSInventory hook and show real completion status.

issues.title: Add Loading States to KDS Screens
issues.description: Implement LoadingSpinner during data fetch. Import LoadingSpinner component and show spinner while loading is true.

issues.title: Add Error Handling to KDS Screens
issues.description: Implement ErrorDisplay with retry functionality. Import ErrorDisplay component and show error message if context returns error.

issues.title: End-to-End KDS Workflow Test
issues.description: Test complete KDS workflow with real data. Create test event in Supabase, add courses and table groups, fire courses, verify appearance on station screens, and bump items.

issues.title: Analyze Current Inventory Flow
issues.description: Document current bumpItemWithInventory() implementation. Identify current operation order, document failure scenarios, and identify data inconsistency risks.

issues.title: Implement Reverse Operation Order
issues.description: Decrement inventory before marking order as done. Call decrementInventoryForOrderItem() first, only bump item if decrement succeeds.

issues.title: Add Comprehensive Error Handling
issues.description: Ensure both operations rolled back on any failure. Catch all error types, log error details, show user-friendly error message.

issues.title: Write Rollback Test Cases
issues.description: Create test suite for inventory rollback scenarios. Test successful bump + decrement, decrement failure, network errors, and database errors.

issues.title: Profile Current KDS Queries
issues.description: Identify N+1 query pattern in KDS context. Enable query logging, load event with multiple fired courses, count total queries executed.

issues.title: Implement Batch Query for Order Items
issues.description: Load all order items in single query instead of per-course. Replace per-course queries with single batch query using .in() filter.

issues.title: Implement Client-Side Grouping
issues.description: Group items by fired course after batch fetch. Create grouping function and group items by fired_course_id.

issues.title: Performance Benchmark
issues.description: Measure query performance improvement. Measure query time before/after optimization and calculate improvement percentage.

issues.title: Design Unified Auth Flow
issues.description: Document integration points between Manus OAuth and Supabase Auth. Create unified flow diagram and document token exchange process.

issues.title: Update Backend OAuth Endpoint
issues.description: Return both Manus and Supabase tokens from login. Modify /api/auth/login endpoint to generate Supabase token on Manus login.

issues.title: Update use-auth.ts Hook
issues.description: Integrate hook with Supabase session. Store both Manus and Supabase tokens and sync session state.

issues.title: Update auth-context.tsx
issues.description: Remove duplicate auth logic, use unified flow. Remove duplicate auth state and use single auth context.

issues.title: Test Unified Auth Flow
issues.description: Test login on mobile and web. Verify both Manus and Supabase sessions created and work correctly.

issues.title: Remove Deprecated Auth Code
issues.description: Clean up old authentication implementations. Identify and remove deprecated code, old auth contexts, and old auth hooks.

issues.title: Design Token Storage Format
issues.description: Define structure for storing tokens with expiration. Define StoredToken interface and document storage location.

issues.title: Implement getValidToken() Function
issues.description: Check expiration and refresh if needed. Create getValidToken() function that checks if token expired and calls refresh endpoint if needed.

issues.title: Add Backend Refresh Endpoint
issues.description: Create POST /api/auth/refresh endpoint. Accept refreshToken parameter and return new token and refreshToken.

issues.title: Integrate Refresh into API Calls
issues.description: Auto-refresh before each API call. Update API client to call getValidToken() before making request.

issues.title: Test Token Expiration Scenarios
issues.description: Test all token refresh scenarios. Test with valid token, expired token, expiring soon token, and refresh failure.

issues.title: Add CSRF Token Generation on Backend
issues.description: Generate and set CSRF token cookie on login. Generate random CSRF token and set as httpOnly cookie with secure flag.

issues.title: Add CSRF Validation Middleware
issues.description: Validate CSRF token on all mutations. Create validateCsrfToken middleware and apply to all POST/PUT/DELETE routes.

issues.title: Update API Client to Include CSRF Token
issues.description: Read CSRF token from cookie and add to headers. Create getCsrfToken() function and add to X-CSRF-Token header.

issues.title: Test CSRF Protection
issues.description: Verify CSRF protection works. Test valid token accepted, missing token rejected, invalid token rejected.

issues.description: Define TypeScript interfaces for all service parameters. Create EventParams, UpdateEventParams, StaffParams, ClientParams, InvoiceParams, and MenuItemParams interfaces.

issues.title: Update Event Service Functions
issues.description: Apply EventParams types to all event functions. Update createEvent(), updateEvent(), getEvents(), and getEvent() signatures.

issues.title: Update Staff Service Functions
issues.description: Apply StaffParams types to all staff functions. Update createStaff(), updateStaff(), and getStaff() signatures.

issues.title: Update Client Service Functions
issues.description: Apply ClientParams types to all client functions. Update createClient(), updateClient(), and getClients() signatures.

issues.title: Update Invoice Service Functions
issues.description: Apply InvoiceParams types to all invoice functions. Update createInvoice(), updateInvoice(), and getInvoices() signatures.

issues.title: Fix TypeScript Errors in Components
issues.description: Update form components to use typed services. Update EventForm, StaffForm, ClientForm, and InvoiceForm components.

issues.title: Create use-crud-list Hook
issues.description: Generic hook for CRUD list management. Accept fetchFn and searchKeys parameters, implement search filtering and form management.

issues.title: Refactor Events Page
issues.description: Use use-crud-list hook instead of duplicate code. Import hook and remove duplicate state management and search logic.

issues.title: Refactor Clients Page
issues.description: Use use-crud-list hook instead of duplicate code. Import hook and remove duplicate code.

issues.title: Refactor Staff Page
issues.description: Use use-crud-list hook instead of duplicate code. Import hook and remove duplicate code.

issues.title: Refactor Menus Page
issues.description: Use use-crud-list hook instead of duplicate code. Import hook and remove duplicate code.

issues.title: Regression Testing
issues.description: Test all pages for functionality after refactoring. Test search, create, edit, delete functionality on all pages.

issues.title: Plan Service Modularization
issues.description: Design directory structure and module organization. Plan web/lib/services/ directory and list functions for each service.

issues.title: Extract events.ts Service
issues.description: Move event CRUD operations to separate file. Create events.ts and move createEvent, updateEvent, deleteEvent, getEvents, getEvent.

issues.title: Extract clients.ts Service
issues.description: Move client CRUD operations to separate file. Create clients.ts and move client functions.

issues.title: Extract staff.ts Service
issues.description: Move staff CRUD operations to separate file. Create staff.ts and move staff functions.

issues.title: Extract assignments.ts Service
issues.description: Move staff assignments and conflict detection. Create assignments.ts and move assignment and conflict detection functions.

issues.title: Extract invoices.ts Service
issues.description: Move invoice CRUD operations to separate file. Create invoices.ts and move invoice functions.

issues.title: Extract templates.ts Service
issues.description: Move invoice template operations to separate file. Create templates.ts and move template functions.

issues.title: Extract realtime.ts Service
issues.description: Move all subscriptions to separate file. Create realtime.ts and move subscription functions.

issues.title: Create index.ts for Re-exports
issues.description: Maintain backward compatibility with re-exports. Create index.ts and re-export all services.

issues.title: Update All Imports Across Web App
issues.description: Update import statements to use new service structure. Update imports in all pages, components, and hooks.

issues.title: Regression Testing for Services
issues.description: Test all services for functionality after refactoring. Test all CRUD operations, subscriptions, and conflict detection.

issues.title: Create service-result.ts Type
issues.description: Define ServiceResult<T> union type. Create ServiceResult type with success and failure variants.

issues.title: Update KDS Services
issues.description: Apply ServiceResult to all KDS service functions. Update all KDS service functions to return ServiceResult<T>.

issues.title: Update Inventory Services
issues.description: Apply ServiceResult to all inventory service functions. Update all inventory service functions to return ServiceResult<T>.

issues.title: Update Web ERP Services
issues.description: Apply ServiceResult to all Web ERP service functions. Update all service functions to return ServiceResult<T>.

issues.title: Update UI Components
issues.description: Update components to handle new error format. Update form and page components to handle success/error uniformly.

issues.title: Test Error Handling
issues.description: Test error handling across all services. Test successful operations, failed operations, error messages, and error recovery.

issues.title: Analyze Both Queue Implementations
issues.description: Document differences between two offline queue systems. Review lib/offline-queue.ts and shared/offline-sync-manager.ts.

issues.title: Deprecate Simple offline-queue.ts
issues.description: Mark simple queue as deprecated. Add @deprecated JSDoc comment and migration guide.

issues.title: Migrate KDS to OfflineSyncManager
issues.description: Update KDS context to use comprehensive offline system. Import OfflineSyncManager and replace simple queue.

issues.title: Create offline-sync-helpers.ts
issues.description: Add KDS-specific operation helpers. Create helpers for bumpItem, fireCourse, and markCoursePlated.

issues.title: Test Offline KDS Operations
issues.description: Test complete offline workflow. Test bump item offline, fire course offline, and sync on reconnect.

issues.title: Design Conflict Detection Strategy
issues.description: Document how to detect conflicts (HTTP 409). Document 409 response handling and conflict data structure.

issues.title: Implement Conflict Detection in Sync Manager
issues.description: Catch 409 responses and trigger conflict handling. Extract server data from response and trigger conflict resolution flow.

issues.title: Implement Client-Wins Strategy
issues.description: Force update with client data on conflict. Implement client-wins resolver and force update with client data.

issues.title: Implement Server-Wins Strategy
issues.description: Accept server data and discard client changes. Implement server-wins resolver and accept server data.

issues.title: Implement Manual Strategy with Resolver
issues.description: Allow custom merge logic for conflicts. Implement manual resolver and allow custom merge function.

issues.title: Add Conflict UI (Web + Mobile)
issues.description: Show conflict dialog with resolution options. Create ConflictResolutionDialog (web) and ConflictResolutionSheet (mobile).

issues.title: Test Conflict Scenarios
issues.description: Test concurrent edits and conflict resolution. Test concurrent updates, client-wins, server-wins, and manual resolution.

issues.description: Define query parameter format for filters. Design filter object structure and define parameter names.

issues.description: Add search, status, and date range filters. Implement Supabase query with filters.

issues.title: Update getStaff() with Filters
issues.description: Add search, department, and status filters. Implement Supabase query with filters.

issues.title: Update getClients() with Filters
issues.description: Add search and status filters. Implement Supabase query with filters.

issues.title: Add Pagination to All Queries
issues.description: Implement limit/offset pagination. Add limit and offset parameters to all queries.

issues.title: Update UI to Use Server Filters
issues.description: Replace client-side filtering with server calls. Update Events, Staff, and Clients pages.

issues.title: Performance Testing with Large Datasets
issues.description: Test performance with 10,000+ records. Create test data and measure response times.
